title: Assemble the canonical derived residue tensor square
statement: Use [new-integral-residue-tensor-geometry]. For each f:X→Y there is a strong monoidal structure on the actual integral derived pullback together with natural right-tensor presentations tY and tX of restricted reduction. The coefficient in tY is B_Y and that in tX is f*B_Y. Their tensor compatibility equation uses the canonical restriction/pullback square and the inverse canonical coherent scalar pull comparison. The witnesses are the explicitly constructed ordinary-derived monoidal structure and the two canonical tensor presentations. The pull square, coefficient object and canonical monoidal instance are those of [new-integral-residue-derived-pull-square], [new-integral-residue-tensor-presentation], and [new-integral-residue-derived-monoidal].

lean.statement:
theorem integralResidue_tensorSquare {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ∃ m : (residueExchangeUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).Monoidal,
      letI := m
      ∃ (tY : residueExchangeReduction ℓ E Y ⋙ residueExchangeRestriction ℓ E Y ≅
            tensorRight (residueExchangeCoefficient ℓ E Y))
        (tX : residueExchangeReduction ℓ E X ⋙ residueExchangeRestriction ℓ E X ≅
            tensorRight ((residueExchangeUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).obj
              (residueExchangeCoefficient ℓ E Y))),
        ∀ M : residueExchangeDerived (integralCoeff ℓ E) Y,
          (residueExchangeUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).map (tY.hom.app M) ≫
              Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (residueExchangeUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f)
                M (residueExchangeCoefficient ℓ E Y) =
            (residueExchangeRestrictPullIso ℓ E f).hom.app
                ((residueExchangeReduction ℓ E Y).obj M) ≫
              (residueExchangeRestriction ℓ E X).map
                (((residueExchangePullComparisons ℓ E).pull f).inv.app M) ≫
              tX.hom.app ((residueExchangeUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).obj M)
